route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81dvbk_selc/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81dvbk_selc/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81dvbk_selc --out {RUN}/record/views/dsdv_bksel_c  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81U-BK2: the selector's control as its OWN leaf (25.2k sinks, closed mrg variant: TT insertion 324.9 ps) instead of flattened with the V glue (sel_lm 30,768 sinks, 564 ps / 94.7 ps). Configuration SLAT 4 / XDX 1 is the one the CLOSED PIPE2 / QIO quarter tiles (s81b-selt_q2-frprildb) need; it has no closed view (s81b-selt_c-xdx-mm2 NEEDS_RTL TT -28.4 / FF -13.0). Per-face ports: W quarters 0/2, E quarters 1/3, vd + ck + rst S (the shared glue leaf dsdv_bk_g sits S of it, as under the collector's merger).
